item.title: Compliance Framework - Documentation
item.description:
Compliance Framework Philosophy

CCASH's compliance framework is designed as a comprehensive policy infrastructure that combines legal governance with technology-enforced controls. The framework is risk-based, proportional to operational profile, and designed to be maintained and audited through the CCASH platform's tooling.

<h2>Policy Infrastructure</h2>
<p>The compliance policy infrastructure consists of written policies covering customer identification and verification, customer due diligence, transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, and reporting obligations. Policies are maintained within the CCASH platform and updated as regulatory requirements evolve.</p>

<h2>AI-Assisted Monitoring</h2>
<p>CCASH employs AI-assisted monitoring to analyze transaction patterns, detect anomalies, and flag potential compliance issues. The AI monitoring system is configurable per-operator, allowing risk parameters to be tuned to each operator's specific business model and risk appetite.</p>

<h2>Four-Eyes Governance</h2>
<p>The following actions require two distinct authorized signers with cryptographic signature verification:</p>
<ul>
    <li>High-tier transactions above threshold</li>
    <li>Customer verification final approval</li>
    <li>Override decisions on flagged items</li>
    <li>Refunds and reversals above threshold</li>
    <li>Policy exception approvals</li>
</ul>

<h2>Audit Trail</h2>
<p>All compliance actions are recorded in an immutable audit trail with cryptographic verification. The audit trail provides complete visibility into who performed what action, when, and with what authorization, supporting both internal governance and external review.</p>

item.title: Getting Started - Documentation
item.description:
Understanding the CCASH Model

CCASH provides a complete legal infrastructure and technology platform for regulated financial services. The platform operates on a dual-layer model: a legal infrastructure layer providing the entity structure, governance, and compliance framework, and a technology platform layer providing the Go + HTMX application stack, secure data layer, and deployment tooling.

<h2>Key Concepts</h2>
<ul>
    <li><strong>Legal Infrastructure:</strong> The entity structure, governance framework, and compliance policies that form the regulatory foundation of your operation.</li>
    <li><strong>Technology Platform:</strong> The Go + HTMX application framework, encrypted SQLite data layer, and deployment tooling that powers your services.</li>
    <li><strong>Operator Model:</strong> Operators deploy branded instances of the CCASH technology platform within the CCASH legal framework, serving their own customers under their own brand.</li>
    <li><strong>Scaling:</strong> The growth path from initial deployment to full-scale operation on the CCASH platform.</li>
</ul>

<h2>Accessing the Legal Framework Documentation</h2>
<p>The legal framework documentation covers entity structure, governance policies, compliance procedures, and operational agreements. All documentation is available through the knowledge base and is organized by category for easy reference.</p>

<h2>Deploying the Go + HTMX Application Platform</h2>
<p>The CCASH technology platform is built with Go and HTMX, providing a modern, lightweight application stack. Deployment follows a straightforward process: clone the platform repository, configure your brand profile, set up the encrypted SQLite data layer, and deploy via the included tooling. Detailed deployment instructions are available in the platform documentation.</p>

<h2>Configuring Your Brand Profile</h2>
<p>Each operator configures their brand profile, including branding assets, domain configuration, and operational preferences. The brand profile is stored in the encrypted data layer and controls the customer-facing experience.</p>

<h2>Next Steps</h2>
<ul>
    <li>Review the <a href="{{ "knowledge/docs/platform-overview/" | relURL }}">Platform Architecture</a> documentation for a detailed understanding of the system.</li>
    <li>Explore the <a href="{{ "knowledge/docs/compliance-framework/" | relURL }}">Compliance Framework</a> for details on policies and procedures.</li>
    <li>Browse the <a href="{{ "knowledge/glossary/" | relURL }}">Glossary</a> for definitions of key terms.</li>
</ul>

item.title: Platform Architecture - Documentation
item.description:
Dual-Layer Model

CCASH is built on a dual-layer architecture. The legal infrastructure layer provides the entity structure, governance framework, and compliance policies. The technology platform layer provides the Go + HTMX application stack, encrypted data layer, and deployment tooling. Operators deploy within this combined framework, benefiting from both the legal foundation and the technology platform.

<h2>Entity Structure and Governance</h2>
<p>The legal infrastructure layer defines an entity model with clear role separation. Operators establish their operating entities within this framework, with defined governance roles, approval workflows, and policy infrastructure. The four-eyes principle ensures that critical actions require multi-person approval.</p>

<h2>Go + HTMX Application Architecture</h2>
<p>The technology platform is built with Go for the backend and HTMX for the frontend, providing a modern, performant application stack. Key components include:</p>
<ul>
    <li><strong>Go Backend:</strong> High-performance API server with built-in middleware for authentication, authorization, and audit logging</li>
    <li><strong>HTMX Frontend:</strong> Lightweight, hypermedia-driven interface that delivers a responsive user experience without heavy JavaScript frameworks</li>
    <li><strong>Encrypted SQLite Data Layer:</strong> Per-operator encrypted SQLite databases providing data isolation at rest</li>
    <li><strong>Deployment Tooling:</strong> Automated deployment scripts and configuration management</li>
</ul>

<h2>Security Model</h2>
<p>The CCASH security model is built on least-privilege access, defense in depth, and cryptographic verification:</p>
<ul>
    <li><strong>Solana Signatures:</strong> Critical actions require on-chain signature verification through Solana, providing a cryptographic audit trail</li>
    <li><strong>Encrypted SQLite:</strong> All data at rest is encrypted using per-operator keys, ensuring data isolation even at the storage layer</li>
    <li><strong>Four-Eyes Approval:</strong> Multi-person authorization for sensitive operations</li>
    <li><strong>Audit Trail:</strong> All actions are logged with cryptographic verification for non-repudiation</li>
</ul>

<h2>Data Isolation</h2>
<p>Each operator's data is isolated at multiple levels. The encrypted SQLite data layer ensures that no operator can access another operator's data. Access controls are enforced at the application layer, and all data access is logged and auditable.</p>
